name: Performance Validation
description: Source Code must meet declared latency, throughput and resource targets under sustained load, with no detected memory leak, before Release.

conditions.statement: P95 latency under declared load is at or below the SLA target.

requiredEvidence.title: Performance Report — P95 Latency
requiredEvidence.description: P95 latency under declared load is at or below the SLA target.

conditions.statement: Throughput under declared load meets or exceeds the minimum requests-per-second target.

requiredEvidence.title: Performance Report — Throughput
requiredEvidence.description: Throughput under declared load meets or exceeds the minimum requests-per-second target.

conditions.statement: No memory leak detected over a sustained load-test window (memory usage returns to baseline after load subsides).

requiredEvidence.title: Performance Report — Memory Profile
requiredEvidence.description: No memory leak detected over a sustained load-test window (memory usage returns to baseline after load subsides).

conditions.statement: CPU and memory utilisation under peak declared load remain below the declared ceiling.

requiredEvidence.title: Performance Report — Resource Utilisation
requiredEvidence.description: CPU and memory utilisation under peak declared load remain below the declared ceiling.
